lines: // Current evidence can establish a different value or explicitly attest absence.
.decl drift(run: symbol, token: symbol, desired_ref: symbol, observed_ref: symbol)
drift(r, t, d, o) :- desired(r, t, expected, d), current(r, t, "known", observed, o), expected != observed.
drift(r, t, d, o) :- desired(r, t, _, d), current(r, t, "absent", _, o).
